notes: Ten student attempts, each with exactly one line flagged mistake=true; every later line follows from that mistake. Line text uses matplotlib mathtext between $...$. judge_keywords: every entry must appear in a diagnosis (case-insensitive); an entry with '|' is satisfied by any one of its alternatives. false_blame_keywords: any one appearing means the answer blamed a correct line. attempts.title: Tangent line
attempts.problem: Find the equation of the tangent line to the curve $y = \sin(x^2)$ at the point where $x = \sqrt{\pi}$.
attempts.mistake: Line 3 writes dy/dx = cos(x^2), dropping the chain-rule factor 2x; dy/dx = 2x cos(x^2), so the slope at sqrt(pi) is -2 sqrt(pi).
attempts.correct_result: slope -2 sqrt(pi); tangent y = -2 sqrt(pi) x + 2 pi

attempts.title: Area between curves
attempts.problem: Find the area of the region enclosed by $y = x$ and $y = x^2$ for $0 \leq x \leq 1$. Sketch the region.
attempts.mistake: Line 2 integrates x^2 - x (lower minus upper); on [0, 1] the line y = x is above y = x^2, so the integrand is x - x^2 and the area is +1/6 (an area cannot be negative).

attempts.title: Block on a rough incline
attempts.problem: A 2 kg block slides down a rough incline at $\theta = 30°$ to the horizontal. The coefficient of kinetic friction is $\mu_k = 0.2$. Draw a free-body diagram and find the acceleration of the block. Take $g = 9.8$ m/s$^2$.

lines.text: Forces: weight $mg$, normal $N$, friction $f$ up the slope

attempts.mistake: Line 3 takes the normal force as N = mg; on the incline N = mg cos θ = 16.97 N, so f = 3.39 N and a = g(sin θ - μ cos θ) ≈ 3.2 m/s^2.
attempts.correct_result: a = g(sin θ - μ_k cos θ) ≈ 3.20 m/s^2

attempts.problem: Two masses, $m_1 = 3$ kg and $m_2 = 5$ kg, hang on either side of a light frictionless pulley (an Atwood machine). Find the acceleration of the masses and the tension in the string. Take $g = 9.8$ m/s$^2$.
